drawio_review_note: Aligned jointly with arXiv:2501.14249 (HLE construction), the official cais/hle release, and arXiv:2602.10604 (the Step 3.5 Flash HLEtext evaluation). HLEtext is not a separately sourced dataset. Full HLE is built from nearly 1,000 experts across 500+ institutions and 50 countries, strict closed-ended submissions, more than 70,000 frontier-model difficulty attempts yielding about 13,000 candidates, 1-3 first-round graduate-expert reviews per item, and organizer/expert approval. The current release has 2,500 public questions plus a private held-out set; 24% are multiple choice, the remainder exact match, and around 14% require images. HLEtext removes image-dependent questions while preserving both answer formats. The Step report does not publish an exact text-subset row count, so none is inferred. It runs one generation per HLE problem, uses HLE's official metric and judgment protocol with gpt-oss-120b as judge, and reports HLEtext pass@1 accuracy.
